messages.author: d718c6bb1db28db2
messages.subject: Re: var M^_i in delta method
parts:
Anne, %CV is given by Distance. If you divide this by 100, and square=20
it, you get the ratios you need. (Note that cv(enc rate) is the same as=20
cv(n).) This is covered in the introductory distance sampling book.

Steve Buckland
